name: ReStart Fitness Center & Gym
address: New Al Madina Supermarket, Al Zarooni Building - HC Floor - Rolla Street - Bur Dubai - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Anil Swamy
reviews.text:
I would like to appreciate my gym trainer Mr.Arun. He is an excellent, certified trainer with strong knowledge of fitness and training techniques. He is very patient, motivating, and always pushes his clients to achieve their best results. You can truly call him a “Fit Buddy.”
I am very satisfied with his training sessions and would strongly recommend him to anyone looking to improve their fitness.
I’m also happy to restart my gym journey here—the gym is affordable, and the staff are friendly and supportive.
One small request to the management: please start the sauna and steam facilities as soon as possible. It would greatly enhance the overall experience.

reviews.author: Chrislyn Stephanie
reviews.text:
I joined Restart Gym last August, and I truly don’t regret it at all. From day one, the environment has been incredibly positive, welcoming, and safe.

As someone completely new to the gym, I was a bit nervous at first, but the trainers made all the difference. All the trainers are kind, supportive and helpful which made my journey so much easier.

I took personal training sessions with Coach Jagdish, and he’s truly amazing. He was friendly and supportive throughout. I told him I wanted to focus on strength training and reduce lower body fat, and he planned my workouts accordingly. But more than that, I ended up building overall strength too. Within 5 months, I could clearly see the results, and I was genuinely happy with my progress.

Now, the gym has become my happy place. It’s always clean, well-maintained, and properly equipped. The people there are genuinely supportive and kind, which makes such a big difference.

Thank you Restart for changing my life 🤍

reviews.author: anil salve
reviews.text: I've been training at ReStart Fitness Center & Gym for a while now, and it's been a great experience. The gym is clean, has all the equipment you need, and the atmosphere is very motivating. A special thanks to Mr. Arun Kumar, who is always supportive and pushes you to do your best. Highly recommend this place to anyone serious about fitness.

reviews.author: haris
reviews.text:
The gym has good equipment, but the biggest issue is the lack of attention from most trainers. They are not bothered about what exercises members are doing, and they don’t properly teach how to use the machines or perform exercises with the correct form. This can be risky, especially for beginners.

The only trainer who genuinely helps everyone is Showrya. He gives proper instructions, corrects form, and provides good guidance during workouts. His training and support are the main positive experience in this gym.

I hope the management improves the involvement and professionalism of the other trainers.

reviews.author: Arshdeep Singh
reviews.text: Shourya sir is the best fitness coach i have ever meet  Always motivate and push to lift more.guys if u want to start your fitness journey come train with shourya sir and team . Thank u

reviews.author: Mohamed Idris
reviews.text:
I would like to share my feedback regarding my trainer, Jagadish. Honestly, he is a very kind and professional person. Even though I joined recently, I had a training session with him, and during that time I learned many useful things about my body and fitness.
He has strong knowledge of physical training and explains everything very clearly. His way of communicating is excellent, which makes it easy to understand and follow his guidance. I truly appreciate his support and dedication.
Overall, the gym environment is also very good. The atmosphere is positive, and the staff and members are friendly, which makes the experience even better.💕

reviews.author: Dija Dev
reviews.text:

Moreover, the gym has a wide range of facilities with great equipments. I recommend everyone to join this gym for a fruitful outcome.

reviews.author: Gaurav kumar
reviews.text:
I recently completed the T-99 Total Transformation Program, and it has been an amazing experience from start to finish. The program is very well structured and focuses not only on workouts but also on building discipline, consistency, and the right mindset toward fitness.

A special thanks to Coach Jagdish, who conducted the training. His guidance, motivation, and deep knowledge of fitness made a huge difference in my journey. He explains every exercise clearly, ensures proper form, and constantly encourages everyone to push their limits in a safe and effective way. His positive attitude and dedication keep the entire group motivated throughout the program.

What I liked most about this program is the supportive environment and the personal attention given during training sessions. Coach Jagdish genuinely cares about each participant’s progress and always pushes us to become a better version of ourselves.

I highly recommend the T-99  Total Transformation Program to anyone who wants to improve their fitness, build strength, and develop a healthier lifestyle. Thank you, Coach Jagdish, for such an inspiring and transformative experience!

reviews.author: Nachappa kullachanda kalappa
reviews.text:
I would strongly recommend Restart gym and Mr. Arun (Trainer) for your body transformation.
He has strategic planning and workout methods including diet plans for fast recovery and body building.
Gym is well maintained with good ambience.
Staffs are very friendly. Happy workout😊

reviews.author: nisar mohammed
reviews.text:
I’ve been training with Arun Kumar and the experience has been nothing short of exceptional.He is extremely knowledgeable, motivating, and genuinely invested in helping clients reach their fitness goals.

Every session is well-structured, challenging, and tailored to my specific needs and progress. Arun not only focuses on form and technique but also educates about nutrition and recovery, which has made a big difference in overall results.

What really sets him apart is the positive attitude and constant encouragement. Whether it’s early mornings or tough workouts,Arun always brings energy and focus to the session.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a dedicated, professional, and inspiring trainer!

Arun❤️👍

reviews.author: Kabita Ghimire
reviews.text: Had my first session today with Coach Jagdis sir and it was a great experience. The coach was very friendly, supportive, and made me feel comfortable even though I was nervous on my first day at the gym. The guidance and teaching style were excellent. Really enjoyed the session and looking forward to continuing 💪🤸‍♀️

reviews.author: anandhakrishnan suresh
reviews.text: Great experience overall! Trainer Cijil is very friendly, supportive, and professional. Excellent guidance and service, with a great atmosphere. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rohit Daga
reviews.text:
I've been working out at restart fitness for the past few days and I must say it's been an excellent experience! The facility is clean, well-equipped, and has a positive and motivating atmosphere. Whether you're a beginner or a regular gym-goer, this place has everything you need for a complete workout.

A special shoutout to Jagdish (trainer) who has been an incredible support. They are knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely passionate about helping clients reach their goals. He not only creates effective workout routines but also pays close attention to form and technique, which has really helped me improve.

What I appreciate the most is the personalized approach and encouragement that keeps me motivated every session.

If you're looking for a great gym with a dedicated trainer who truly cares, I highly recommend restart fitness.
